label: Characterization of a mouse model to study mechanisms of hemophilia A pain.
summary: Pain is a debilitating feature of hemophilia A (HA), yet it remains understudied. We developed models of chronic and acute pain in factor VIII knock-out (FVIIIKO; B6;129S-FVIIItm1Kaz/J), demonstrating characteristic features of hemarthrosis pain and gait. Using these models, we examined the mechanisms involving inflammation and vascular changes triggered by bleeding to produce pain.
